reason: A Feynman learning-mode plugin that guides structured explanations, teach-back questions, and targeted re-explanations, with lessons rendered as rich HTML cards.

summaries.zh: 通过费曼学习法引导模型讲解概念、发起复述练习并针对知识缺口重新讲解，同时以富 HTML 卡片展示课程内容。
summaries.en: Guides the model through Feynman-style explanations, teach-back exercises, and targeted re-explanations while displaying lessons as rich HTML cards.

capabilities: Adds a session-scoped learning mode enabled by /learn on|off
Injects Feynman-method teaching guidance into the model prompt while enabled
Registers a teach tool that produces structured lesson cards with prose, code, diagrams, and analogies
Uses ask_user_question for teach-back exercises and feedback
Renders lesson cards with syntax-highlighted code and Mermaid diagrams
Sanitizes optional HTML lesson content in the client
